definitions: Each of the series of slender curved bones articulated in pairs to the spine and largely enclosing the thoracic cavity.
A structural member in a wing or other part of an aircraft, typically running from the front to the back.
A prominent, typically rounded, raised strip on the surface of cloth, a road, or other material.
A cut of meat including one or more ribs.
examples: The aircraft's wing ribs were damaged.
We had a delicious plate of ribs.
